333 days is 330 days + 3 days.  
330 days = 11 months of 30 days each (for simpler calculation, but actual months vary).  
Better: 333 days = 1 year (365 days) – 32 days.  
Adding 1 year to 1009-04-04 gives 1010-04-04.  
Subtract 32 days: March has 31 days, so 1010-04-04 minus 32 days = 1010-04-04 minus 4 days = 1010-03-31, minus another 28 days = 1010-03-03.  

Check: 1010-03-03 to 1010-04-04 is 32 days difference.  
Thus 1009-04-04 + 365 days = 1010-04-04, then subtract 32 days = 1010-03-03.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1010-03-03
